caption: The drawing shows a large, round plate with a shallow, reddish-brown base beneath it. The surface of the plate is decorated with a detailed design featuring several birds and various plant motifs. The color palette includes earthy tones such as brown, yellow, green, and dark red, which are used to create both the background and the intricate decorative elements. The plate’s surface is filled with images of birds perched on branches, surrounded by stylized leaves and floral patterns, all contained within a circular border inside the plate. Green patches and highlights appear sporadically across the plate to accentuate the design. The entire composition is centrally aligned, with the plate shown in a direct frontal view and the base depicted in a flat, horizontal orientation beneath it.
title: Pa. German Plate
